t: A two-core wireless chip built for Bluetooth LE Audio and Matter devices.
steps: Buy the nRF5340 DK from DigiKey or Newark for about 49 US dollars.
Plug it into your computer with a USB cable that carries data.
Install the free nRF Connect for VS Code extension with the nRF Connect SDK.
Build the Blinky sample for the DK and flash it to see an LED blink.
Try a Bluetooth peripheral sample next and find the board in a phone app.
Try CircuitPython on the DK for quick experiments.
Explore the LE Audio or Matter samples next.
